title: Colours & Clothes (颜色与衣服)
description: Name colours and items of clothing, choose between 穿 and 戴 when getting dressed, describe what someone is wearing, like and dislike things with 喜欢, and use simple shopping phrases.

notes.heading: 🎨 Colours (颜色 yánsè)
notes.body:
The word for 'colour' itself is 颜色 **yánsè**. Many colour words add 色 **sè** (colour) after them, especially when naming the colour rather than describing something.

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 红色 | hóngsè | red |
| 黄色 | huángsè | yellow |
| 蓝色 | lánsè | blue |
| 绿色 | lǜsè | green |
| 黑色 | hēisè | black |
| 白色 | báisè | white |
| 紫色 | zǐsè | purple |
| 橙色 | chéngsè | orange |
| 粉色 | fěnsè | pink |

💡 **Worked Example:** 红色 hóngsè is a lucky colour in China — it is used at weddings and festivals.

📎 **Key Point:** when a colour describes a noun directly, you often drop 色: 红苹果 (red apple), 蓝天 (blue sky).

notes.heading: 👕 Clothes & Accessories (衣服 yīfu)
notes.body:
Essential clothing vocabulary:

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 衣服 | yīfu | clothes |
| T恤 | T-xù | T-shirt |
| 裤子 | kùzi | trousers / pants |
| 裙子 | qúnzi | skirt / dress |
| 鞋子 | xiézi | shoes |
| 袜子 | wàzi | socks |
| 帽子 | màozi | hat / cap |
| 外套 | wàitào | coat / jacket |
| 眼镜 | yǎnjìng | glasses |

💡 **Worked Example:** 我的鞋子是黑色的。Wǒ de xiézi shì hēisè de. — My shoes are black.

📎 **Key Points:**
- Measure words: 件 **jiàn** for tops (一件T恤), 条 **tiáo** for trousers and skirts (一条裤子), 双 **shuāng** for pairs like shoes and socks (一双鞋).
- 子 **zi** is a light, neutral-tone ending on many nouns.

notes.heading: 👗 Two Verbs for 'Wear': 穿 and 戴
notes.body:
Chinese uses **two different verbs** for putting things on:

- **穿 chuān** — for clothes, trousers, skirts, socks and shoes (things your body goes into)
- **戴 dài** — for hats, glasses, watches and jewellery (things attached on top)

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 穿衣服 | chuān yīfu | to put on / wear clothes |
| 穿鞋子 | chuān xiézi | to wear shoes |
| 戴帽子 | dài màozi | to wear a hat |
| 戴眼镜 | dài yǎnjìng | to wear glasses |

💡 **Worked Example:** 他穿着T恤，戴着帽子。Tā chuānzhe T-xù, dàizhe màozi. — He is wearing a T-shirt and a hat. (着 **zhe** marks an ongoing state.)

⚠️ **Common Mistake:** never say 穿帽子 — a hat is put on with 戴, not 穿.

notes.heading: 🔑 Describing What Someone Wears
notes.body:
**Pattern:** person + 穿/戴 (+ 着) + measure word + colour + item

💡 **Worked Example:**
- 她穿着一条红色的裙子。Tā chuānzhe yì tiáo hóngsè de qúnzi. — She is wearing a red skirt.
- 我穿着一件蓝色的外套。Wǒ chuānzhe yí jiàn lánsè de wàitào. — I am wearing a blue coat.
- 他戴着一顶帽子。Tā dàizhe yì dǐng màozi. — He is wearing a hat.

🔑 **How it works:**
- A colour before a noun needs 的: 红色的裙子 (a red skirt).
- 着 **zhe** after 穿/戴 shows the state of 'is wearing' right now.
- Word order in Chinese: measure word + description + 的 + noun — the opposite of English, where the adjective hugs the noun closely.

📎 **Key Point:** 顶 **dǐng** is the measure word for hats.

notes.heading: 🛍️ Simple Shopping Phrases
notes.body:
Useful language for a clothes shop:

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 买 | mǎi | to buy |
| 我要买… | wǒ yào mǎi … | I want to buy … |
| 多少钱？ | duōshao qián? | how much (money)? |
| 这个怎么样？ | zhège zěnmeyàng? | how about this one? |
| 太贵了！ | tài guì le! | too expensive! |
| 好看 | hǎokàn | good-looking / nice |

💡 **Worked Example:**
A: 我要买一条裤子。Wǒ yào mǎi yì tiáo kùzi. — I want to buy a pair of trousers.
B: 这条怎么样？Zhè tiáo zěnmeyàng? — How about this pair?
A: 很好看！Hěn hǎokàn! — Very nice!

📎 **Key Point:** 太…了 **tài … le** means 'too …' — 太贵了 (too expensive), 太大了 (too big).

notes.heading: ❤️ Likes & Dislikes: 喜欢
notes.body:
**喜欢 xǐhuan** means 'to like'. Its negative uses 不: 不喜欢 (don't like).

**Pattern:** person + (不)喜欢 + thing

💡 **Worked Example:**
- 我喜欢红色。Wǒ xǐhuan hóngsè. — I like red.
- 我不喜欢黑色。Wǒ bù xǐhuan hēisè. — I don't like black.
- 她很喜欢这条裙子。Tā hěn xǐhuan zhè tiáo qúnzi. — She really likes this skirt.

To ask a yes/no question, you can add 吗 or repeat the verb:
- 你喜欢这件T恤吗？Nǐ xǐhuan zhè jiàn T-xù ma? — Do you like this T-shirt?
- 你喜不喜欢这条裤子？Nǐ xǐhuan bù xǐhuan zhè tiáo kùzi? — Do you like these trousers or not?

📎 **Key Points:**
- 不 **bù** goes directly before the verb for negatives (except with 有, which uses 没).
- 很 **hěn** before 喜欢 adds real emphasis: 很喜欢 = really like.

notes.heading: ⚠️ Common Mistakes with Colours & Clothes
notes.body:
Watch out for these frequent errors:

1. **Missing measure word.** Not 我买一裤子 but 我买**一条**裤子 (measure word 条 for trousers).
2. **Wrong verb.** Not 穿帽子 but **戴**帽子 — hats and glasses take 戴.
3. **Missing 的 after a colour.** Not 红裙子 in careful speech but **红色的裙子** — colours need 的 before the noun.
4. **Forgetting tone pairs.** 买 **mǎi** (buy, 3rd tone) vs 卖 **mài** (sell, 4th tone) — the tones are the whole difference!

✅ **Check yourself:**
- 'I am wearing a white T-shirt.' → 我穿着一件白色的T恤。
- 'She is wearing a hat.' → 她戴着帽子。
- 'Do you like this skirt?' → 你喜欢这条裙子吗？

flashcards.definition: Red — a lucky colour in Chinese culture.
flashcards.example: 我喜欢红色。Wǒ xǐhuan hóngsè. (I like red.)
这条裤子是蓝色的。Zhè tiáo kùzi shì lánsè de. (These trousers are blue.)
她有很多衣服。Tā yǒu hěn duō yīfu. (She has a lot of clothes.)

flashcards.definition: Trousers / pants. Measure word: 条 (一条裤子).
flashcards.example: 我要买一条裤子。Wǒ yào mǎi yì tiáo kùzi. (I want to buy a pair of trousers.)

flashcards.definition: Skirt / dress. Measure word: 条 (一条裙子).
flashcards.example: 这条裙子很好看。Zhè tiáo qúnzi hěn hǎokàn. (This skirt is very pretty.)

flashcards.definition: Shoes. Measure word: 双 for a pair (一双鞋).
flashcards.example: 我的鞋子是白色的。Wǒ de xiézi shì báisè de. (My shoes are white.)

flashcards.definition: Hat / cap — worn with the verb 戴, not 穿.
flashcards.example: 他戴着一顶帽子。Tā dàizhe yì dǐng màozi. (He is wearing a hat.)

flashcards.definition: To wear / put on — for clothes, trousers, socks and shoes.
flashcards.example: 我穿着一件外套。Wǒ chuānzhe yí jiàn wàitào. (I am wearing a coat.)

flashcards.definition: To wear / put on — for hats, glasses, watches and jewellery.
flashcards.example: 她戴着眼镜。Tā dàizhe yǎnjìng. (She is wearing glasses.)

flashcards.definition: To like. Negative: 不喜欢 (don't like).
flashcards.example: 你喜不喜欢这件T恤？Nǐ xǐhuan bù xǐhuan zhè jiàn T-xù? (Do you like this T-shirt?)

flashcards.definition: To buy (3rd tone). Its opposite 卖 mài (to sell) has a 4th tone.
flashcards.example: 我想买一条裙子。Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì tiáo qúnzi. (I'd like to buy a skirt.)

flashcards.definition: How about…? / What do you think? Used to ask an opinion.
flashcards.example: 这个怎么样？Zhège zěnmeyàng? (How about this one?)

questions.explanation: 红色 hóngsè means red — a colour of luck and celebration in Chinese culture, seen at festivals and weddings.
裤子 kùzi means trousers or pants. A skirt is 裙子, a hat is 帽子, and shoes are 鞋子.
喜欢 xǐhuan means 'to like': 我喜欢蓝色 (I like blue). Its negative is 不喜欢.
帽子 màozi means hat or cap, and it is worn with the verb 戴: 戴帽子.
买 mǎi (3rd tone) means to buy. Watch the tone — 卖 mài (4th tone) means to sell.

questions.stem: Which verb is correct: 她___着一副眼镜。(She is wearing glasses.)
questions.explanation: Glasses, hats, watches and jewellery are worn with 戴 dài. 穿 is for clothes, trousers, socks and shoes that the body goes into.

questions.stem: How do you say 'a pair of trousers' in Chinese?
choices: 一件裤子 yí jiàn kùzi
一条裤子 yì tiáo kùzi
一双裤子 yì shuāng kùzi
一个裤子 yí ge kùzi
questions.explanation: Trousers and skirts take the measure word 条 tiáo: 一条裤子. 件 is for tops, and 双 is for pairs like shoes and socks.
太…了 means 'too…' and 贵 means expensive, so 太贵了 is 'too expensive' — a classic line when shopping.

questions.stem: 她穿着一条红色的裙子。(Tā chuānzhe yì tiáo hóngsè de qúnzi.) means:
choices: She is wearing a red skirt.
She is wearing a red hat.
questions.explanation: 穿着…裙子 means 'is wearing a skirt', 红色 means red, and 条 is the measure word — so she is wearing a red skirt.

questions.stem: Which question asks 'Do you like this T-shirt?'
choices: 你喜欢这件T恤吗？Nǐ xǐhuan zhè jiàn T-xù ma?
你穿这件T恤吗？Nǐ chuān zhè jiàn T-xù ma?
这件T恤多少钱？Zhè jiàn T-xù duōshao qián?
我要买这件T恤。Wǒ yào mǎi zhè jiàn T-xù.
questions.explanation: 喜欢 (like) + the statement + 吗 makes a yes/no question: 你喜欢这件T恤吗？Choice C asks the price and D is a statement.

questions.stem: 这个怎么样？(Zhège zěnmeyàng?) is used to ask:
choices: What do you think of this one?
questions.explanation: 怎么样 asks for an opinion — 'how about it?' Shop assistants say 这个怎么样？when showing you an item.

questions.stem: Choose the correct sentence for 'I am wearing a blue coat.'
choices: 我戴着一件蓝色的外套。Wǒ dàizhe yí jiàn lánsè de wàitào.
我穿着一件蓝色的外套。Wǒ chuānzhe yí jiàn lánsè de wàitào.
我穿一件外套蓝色。Wǒ chuān yí jiàn wàitào lánsè.
我蓝色穿着外套。Wǒ lánsè chuānzhe wàitào.
questions.explanation: A coat is clothing your body goes into, so it needs 穿; tops take the measure word 件, and the colour comes before the noun with 的: 一件蓝色的外套.

questions.stem: A shopper says 太贵了，我不买了。(Tài guì le, wǒ bù mǎi le.) What happened?
choices: They bought two of the item.
They decided not to buy it because it costs too much.
They asked for a bigger size.
They think the item is too small.
questions.explanation: 太贵了 = too expensive, and 不买了 = won't buy it any more — the shopper walked away because of the price.

choices: 他戴着眼镜，穿着鞋子。Tā dàizhe yǎnjìng, chuānzhe xiézi.
她喜欢不买衣服。Tā xǐhuan bù mǎi yīfu.
questions.explanation: Glasses take 戴 and shoes take 穿, and both pairs are matched correctly here. Hats also take 戴 (not 穿), and skirts take 穿 (not 戴).

questions.stem: In a shop you hear: A: 这条裙子多少钱？B: 两百块。A: 太贵了！这条呢？B: 一百块。What is A most likely doing?
choices: Comparing the prices of two skirts
questions.explanation: A asks the price of one skirt (多少钱？), finds 200 too expensive, and asks about another (这条呢？= and this one?) — clearly comparing prices of two skirts.
